_doc: Two-Mac edit routing (handoff 03, Dan, 2026-11-12; built 2026-11-14). The ONE place for the per-Mac numbers. Change a number here and every tool follows: editcap.py (edit slots), renderq.py (cores), editroute.py (where the next edit goes). README.md beside this file explains each field.

m6.label: M6 (Dan's Mac)
m6.drives_note: No drives of its own. The Extreme and Seagate stay plugged into the M2; since 2026-11-14 they also reach this Mac as network shares at the same names. An M6 edit still works on this Mac's internal SSD (never a heavy encode against a share) and copies the footage it needs with editroute.py fetch. Job folders on a share count as the M2's.

m2.label: M2 Pro (edit machine)
m2.drives_note: Holds the Extreme and Seagate. Work folders use internal SSD if 80 GB reserve remains, then Extreme, then Seagate. M2 edits read local footage in place.
